The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) The bread is removed from the pan and placed on a wire cooling rack. (3) The baker's hands tear the soft, fluffy interior of a sesame toast loaf, highlighting its elastic texture. (4) A large bowl of raw white dough mixed with sesame seeds is shown. (5) Hands divide and roll the dough into small, uniform balls on a marble countertop. (6) A textured white rolling pin is used to flatten pieces of dough into rectangular sheets. (7) The sheets are rolled into cylinders and placed side-by-side into loaf tins. (8) Small round dough balls are shaped for buns and placed on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. (9) Trays of proofed dough are shown, followed by the golden-brown baked results. (10) The video concludes with close-up shots of the hands squeezing and pulling apart the finished toast and buns to show the soft, shredded interior crumb.
